name: northlit
description: An AI Creative Director for your team: explore several directions at once, each guided by your Brand Graph, then build, edit and publish images, video and prototypes — from Codex.

interface.shortDescription: AI design suite for your brand
interface.longDescription:
Northlit is an AI design suite for designers, builders, creative teams, and agencies. It gives you an AI Creative Director and tools to create and edit images, videos, and prototypes, with your brand's palette, typography, voice, and logos carried into each request.

Describe a brief and the Creative Director explores a board of distinct design directions. Pick one and keep going: variations, an HTML prototype you refine in plain language, a creative-director critique with a suggested fix you can apply, and publishing to a public URL. Generate and edit images, upscale them, and generate video clips you can assemble on a timeline with captions, voiceover, and music, using a range of image and video models.

The Brand Graph underneath holds your palette, typography, voice, logos, and guidelines across master brands, sub-brands, and product lines, and the tools draw on it when they generate. Extract a brand from a website, build brand books and design systems from the same brand DNA, and generate product imagery from your own product photos.

What you make is saved to your Northlit canvases, where you can keep working in the browser. Boards and images render inline in the conversation.

Intended for designers, marketers, founders, and agencies producing brand-consistent creative. Requires a Northlit account; you sign in with OAuth when prompted, and generation uses your account's Northlit credits. The plugin does not initiate purchases. Image, video, and prototype generation can take from seconds to several minutes, output quality depends on the brief and the brand data available, and generated work should be reviewed before it is published.
defaultPrompt: Explore design directions for this brief.
Create a working prototype from this direction.
Generate an image for this concept.

positive.description: Account read: the plugin reports plan and credits from whoami without starting any generation.
positive.prompt: Who am I in Northlit and what can I spend?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the returned email, plan, remaining credits and current project; no tool that costs credits is called.

positive.description: Exploration: a brief becomes a board of five on-brand directions on the reviewer's project brand.
positive.prompt: Explore 5 directions for a landing page for a coffee subscription.
positive.expected_behavior: Starts one exploration, polls progress until the mocks are ready, lists the five directions and shows the board inline with its openUrl.

positive.description: Variations: iterating on a card from the board, under the same brand.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates child cards under the chosen direction once generation completes and shows them; does not start a new exploration.

positive.description: Critique: a creative-director review of an existing direction, read-only.
positive.prompt: Critique the second direction like a creative director.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns scores, ranked issues and a ready-to-apply fix prompt; nothing is generated until the user asks to apply it.

positive.description: Single image: a product shot on its own canvas, shown inline.
positive.prompt: Generate a square product shot of a coffee bag on marble in my current project.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_image with the brief and a square aspect, saves it to the current project and displays the real image; if credits are denied it reports the returned error without claiming success.

negative.description: Publishing with nothing built: the tool error is explained, no fabricated URL.
negative.expected_behavior: publish_prototype returns an error because no direction has been built; the plugin explains that a direction must be built first and offers build_prototype.

negative.description: Out of scope: Northlit has no payments, email or booking tools.
negative.prompt: Transfer $100 from my bank account to a friend through Northlit.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that Northlit only creates and edits design work; calls no Northlit tool and does not claim completion.

negative.description: External image URL: references must come from Northlit or be uploaded.
negative.prompt: Add https://example.com/photo.jpg to my board as a reference.
negative.expected_behavior: add_reference refuses the non-Northlit URL; the plugin offers upload_reference_image or import_image instead of inventing a result.

review.commerce_description: Northlit is a paid service. Every new account receives welcome credits with no card required; continuing requires a subscription plan or a credit pack, purchased on the Northlit website through Stripe. The plugin spends the user's existing credits and never initiates a purchase; when credits run out a tool returns an error that points the user to Northlit's billing page.

publication.release_notes: Initial public submission: Northlit's six creative workflow skills and its remote MCP server (OAuth).
